Subject: January 2023 Weight Summary  

Dear [Recipient],

Here is the overview of the weight measurements recorded for the period starting 2023‑01‑01 and ending 2023‑01‑31. During these five entries the highest recorded weight was 85 kg on 2023‑01‑14, while the lowest was 78 kg on 2023‑01‑28. The average weight across the month was 81 kg, reflecting a net change of ‑2 kg compared with the first measurement. In total, five weight readings were logged.

The detailed measurements are as follows: on 2023‑01‑01 at 08:00 UTC the weight was 80.5 kg; on 2023‑01‑07 at 08:00 UTC it was 82.0 kg; on 2023‑01‑14 at 08:00 UTC it peaked at 85.0 kg; on 2023‑01‑21 at 08:00 UTC it recorded 81.0 kg; and on 2023‑01‑28 at 08:00 UTC it reached the low of 78.0 kg.  

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
Health Coach
